## CookieExpiryInfo.parsedMaxAge property

The `Max-Age` attribute parsed to a number of seconds, or `null` if there was no valid `Max-Age` attribute. `'Infinity'`<!-- -->/`'-Infinity'` mirror the corresponding [Cookie.maxAge](./tough-cookie.cookie.maxage.md) values.

**Signature:**

```typescript
parsedMaxAge: number | 'Infinity' | '-Infinity' | null;
```
